title: Token Usage by Agent Role
description: Input and output token consumption broken down by agent type and model

panels.title: Total Tokens by Agent Type (metrics table)
panels.description: Cumulative token_input and token_output from the time-series metrics table, grouped by agent type

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.agent_type, SUM(CASE WHEN m.name = 'token_input' THEN m.value ELSE 0 END) AS input_tokens, SUM(CASE WHEN m.name = 'token_output' THEN m.value ELSE 0 END) AS output_tokens FROM metrics m JOIN agents a ON m.agent_id = a.id WHERE m.name IN ('token_input', 'token_output') GROUP BY a.agent_type ORDER BY input_tokens DESC

panels.title: Token Input Over Time by Agent Type
panels.description: Time series of token_input metric samples, grouped by agent type

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.timestamp AS time, a.agent_type, m.value AS input_tokens FROM metrics m JOIN agents a ON m.agent_id = a.id WHERE m.name = 'token_input' ORDER BY m.timestamp

panels.title: Token Output Over Time by Agent Type
panels.description: Time series of token_output metric samples, grouped by agent type

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.timestamp AS time, a.agent_type, m.value AS output_tokens FROM metrics m JOIN agents a ON m.agent_id = a.id WHERE m.name = 'token_output' ORDER BY m.timestamp

panels.title: Agent Count by Type (snapshot)
panels.description: Number of agents spawned, grouped by agent_type — always has data

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM agents GROUP BY agent_type ORDER BY count DESC
